responsibility: Defines the canonical section-name prefixes and fixed section-name constants used by GCC’s LTO and offload object-file formats. This header centralizes the .gnu.lto_ and .gnu.offload_lto_ naming conventions, the Mach-O segment name for LTO sections, offload variable/function table section names, and the extern declaration for the currently selected prefix used when streaming normal LTO versus offload IR. It supplies naming constants only, not section creation or parsing behavior.
